tonight.headline: Sadiq limited again, and the flex is still a point off
body: Nobody on your roster plays tonight. The bad news is unchanged in kind: Kenyon Sadiq, your only tight end, was limited again Thursday with his back, and no bench player can cover him. ESPN has you at 123.2 against Team 13's 112.2, 55%.

One thing to do before Sunday 07:30: the flex still has Tuten where the projection prefers Downs by a point. It's a coin flip, so take the projection (card 1). If Sadiq is ruled out, Mark Andrews is a free agent and practised fully Thursday.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Team 13 start Josh Allen (no designation). DeVonta Smith (hamstring) did not practise Thursday (SI 1 Oct) and their RB2 Rachaad White (shoulder) missed Wednesday and Thursday (Commanders.com). Lamar Jackson, on their bench, was upgraded to full (ProFootballTalk 1 Oct).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Smith and White both ruled out Friday: Team 13 lose two starters unless they fill from DJ Moore and Blake Corum, and your win probability rises.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Before Sun 07:30 Mexico City (Downs locks in London)
doFirst.title: Put Downs back in the flex over Tuten
doFirst.subtitle: 13.7 to 12.7. Carried from this morning and still not done. A coin flip, so it goes to the projection — and no thesis.

case.label: The rule
case.body: lineup_check.py: 'start Josh Downs 13.7 over Bhayshul Tuten 12.7 — COIN FLIP, take the projection.' Neither has news ESPN hasn't priced: both are off Thursday's reports (Yahoo; Jaguars.com 1 Oct).

case.label: The player
case.body: Downs drew 11 targets in Week 3, a third of Indianapolis' (archive), with Pierce on IR. Keenan Allen was limited again Thursday with a groin issue on top of rest (RotoWire 1 Oct). Washington have allowed the most points to receivers (footballdb).

case.label: The timing cost
case.body: Downs locks at 07:30 in London, Tuten at 11:00. Putting Downs in the flex gives up a little late flexibility, but nothing on this roster is waiting on a later inactive except Sadiq, and only a tight end covers him.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Tuten outscores Downs. It's a coin flip: this is the expected-value call, not a prediction, and it gets no decision-log entry.

doFirst.sources: lineup_check.py · RotoWire · Yahoo · Jaguars.com · footballdb · Week 3 archive

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · if Sadiq is ruled out Friday or inactive at Sun 09:30 Mexico City; both lock at 11:00
doFirst.title: If Sadiq sits: add Mark Andrews, drop Carnell Tate
doFirst.subtitle: Carried. Andrews is a free agent, so it's an add with no priority cost.

case.label: The injury
case.body: The Jets' report lists Sadiq limited with a back injury Wednesday and again Thursday; Mason Taylor DNP both days and Ruckert limited (NewYorkJets.com 1 Oct). No coach has spoken to his availability. ESPN: QUESTIONABLE at 9.9.

case.label: The fallback
case.body: Andrews projects 10.1 at home to Tennessee and was a full participant Thursday with a hand listing (ProFootballTalk 1 Oct). Against that, Zay Flowers was upgraded to full, which is likelier to shrink Andrews' share than grow it. He's a FREEAGENT in this snapshot: an add, not a claim, and anyone else can make it first.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Carnell Tate, the fifth receiver and not on the screen's exposure list. Golden, Kamara, Gordon and Downs are, so they are never the drop.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: It fires and Andrews scores less than the best free tight end that week (Hunter Henry, Loveland).

whatWentWrong.title: The flex has sat a point below the projection all day
whatWentWrong.lead: Downs went into the flex at 14:10 Wednesday and back out for Tuten at 21:31 that night, Mexico City time. It hasn't moved since.

case.label: Why it matters
case.body: Section 0 of the strategy: every Week 1–2 loss was winnable with the roster owned, and the most expensive mistake was overriding the projection. A one-point flip isn't a disaster; the habit is.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: News ESPN hasn't priced about Downs or Tuten. I found none: both are off Thursday's reports.

whatWentWrong.title: One tight end, limited two days running
whatWentWrong.lead: Back injury, limited Wednesday and Thursday. No bench player can cover the slot.

case.label: The tool
case.body: lineup_check.py: 'NOBODY ELIGIBLE on the bench — find one on the wire.' That's the Andrews card.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Sadiq full on Friday with no designation: nothing fires.

worthALook.name: Bills D/ST
worthALook.lead: The D/ST comparison: Steelers 8.2 and Bills 8.0 are free, the Ravens project 7.3. Hold.

case.label: The comparison
case.body: Steelers 8.2 at Cleveland tonight, the Browns missing both Jenkinses on the line (Steelers.com). Bills 8.0 at home to New England, up 8.7 points of ownership this week. Ravens 7.3 at home to a Titans team that got Tony Pollard back to a full practice Thursday (TennesseeTitans.com), with Trey Hendrickson not practising (ProFootballTalk).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Both gaps are under a point, and the D/ST seat changed hands on Wednesday. The churn rule closes it.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Hendrickson ruled out and the Ravens' number falling a point below a free defence that hasn't kicked off.

worthALook.name: Ka'imi Fairbairn
worthALook.lead: The kicker comparison: 0.1 better than Myers and on waivers until Friday 01:00. Hold.

case.label: The comparison
case.body: Fairbairn 9.8 on waivers, Myers 9.7. A claim costs never-resetting priority for a tenth of a point.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing this week.

doNotChase.name: Keenan Allen
doNotChase.lead: Still the wire's biggest receiver riser, and still the same role reason you already own in Downs.

case.label: The rise
case.body: 27% of Indianapolis targets in Week 3 with Pierce on IR (archive). Limited Wednesday and Thursday; RotoWire lists a groin injury alongside rest (1 Oct).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Downs, yours, drew 11 targets to Allen's 9 in Week 3 (archive) from the same vacancy. Doubling up on one team's opening buys nothing.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Downs hurt.

doNotChase.name: Jaylen Wright
doNotChase.lead: The riser splitting the backfield you spent priority on.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Limited Wednesday and Thursday with the foot, and listed ahead of Gordon on the depth chart since Achane went to IR (Yahoo 1 Oct; Vikings.com report).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: He'd be a fifth back on a roster that starts two, at Minnesota (4th-fewest to RBs, footballdb). A free agent, but a roster seat is still a cost.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Wright takes over Miami outright (Gordon under 8 touches) — then Gordon is the problem to solve, not a reason to own both.

waiverAnalysis.summary: Nothing on the wire beats this roster on usage, from three weeks of data, which is still thin. Same answer as this morning. The only wire need is the Sadiq fallback, an injury plan rather than a usage gap.
